inst_h1: How to install mods in Football Manager
inst_intro: This guide works for almost any mod: graphics, skins, databases and matchday elements. If the mod's page gives a specific path or instructions, always follow those.
inst_b2: Check on the mod's page that it is compatible with your version of the game (FM24, FM26, FM27…).
inst_b3: You need an extraction program, such as 7-Zip or WinRAR.
inst_b4: If the mod is a plugin, you must already have BepInEx Unity (IL2CPP) installed (see the warning below).
inst_b5: Back up the folder you're about to modify if you already have other mods.
inst_bep: ⚠ Plugins need BepInEx. Before installing any plugin you must have BepInEx Unity (IL2CPP) installed. Download it here: https://builds.bepinex.dev/projects/bepinex_be
inst_p1: Download the file with the button on the mod's page. An external service (MediaFire, MEGA, Drive…) will open or, sometimes, the page where the creator published their mod rather than a direct MediaFire or MEGA link.
inst_p3: Open the destination folder. Every mod page has a “Copy install path” button; paste it into the file explorer's address bar.
inst_p4: Create the folder if it doesn't exist (for example graphics or skins) and copy the mod files into it. If asked whether to merge folders, accept.
inst_p5: Open the game. In FM26 and later, graphics load automatically; in FM24 you need to reload the skin (see below).
inst_where_h: Where each type of mod goes
inst_where_p: They sit inside the Football Manager 20XX folder on your system. The subfolders are indicative: some mods (especially real-name patches) specify a different path.
inst_year: Change 2027 to the year of your game version (FM27 → 2027, FM26 → 2026…).
inst_reload_h: Reloading the changes in the game
inst_l1: Graphics, skins, external app and plugins in FM26 or later: you don't need to do anything, they load automatically when you open the game or the app.
inst_l2: Graphics and skins in FM24: go to Preferences → Interface and press the button to reload the skin. If you don't see the changes, clear the cache from the same screen (names may vary depending on the language). To change skin, choose it from the skins dropdown.
inst_l3: Editor data: you choose them when creating a new save, on the database selection screen. They normally don't affect saves already in progress, so you need to start a new one.
inst_q1: I don't see any change: check that the folder has the right game year and that you haven't left an extra folder (for example graphics/graphics).
inst_q2: Faces or logos appear blank: some packs include a config.xml file; don't delete it.
inst_q3: The game is slow after installing a big pack: that's normal the first time, while the cache is being built.
inst_q4: The link doesn't work: use “Report broken link” on the mod's page.
